defect: registers are declared with initial values, which an ASIC flow does not implement
rationale: Declaration initialisers on frame_len_reg and frame_len_valid_reg set a power-up state that ASIC flip-flops do not have; the sync reset makes the intent redundant and the initialiser is an FPGA-only construct.
author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Converted to SystemVerilog, removed the optional tkeep bypass, and sized the length arithmetic.

labels.note: Declaration initializers require ASIC power-up initialization even though reset is also present.
